description:
Make every claim unit test and property test acquire and release leases through the entry points that commands use.

## Background

`ClaimCoordinator::acquire_claim` (`crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs:450`), `acquire_claim_with_reason` (`:527`) and `release_lease` (`:1087`) have no production caller. `jit claim acquire` uses `acquire_claim_synchronized` (`:659`, called at `commands/claim.rs:138`), and `jit claim release` evicts through `execute_claim_release_by_issue` (`commands/claim.rs:334-395`). The test-only methods are called by about 40 coordinator tests, by the property tests in `storage/claim_coordinator_proptests.rs` (including the concurrency props through `acquire_claim_when_reached`, `claim_coordinator.rs:1430-1470`), and by tests in `commands/claim.rs:867,1733`, `commands/worktree.rs:725-726` and `commands/mod.rs:4412`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test calls `acquire_claim`, `acquire_claim_with_reason` or `release_lease`: every coordinator test and property test acquires through `acquire_claim_synchronized` and releases through the production release path, and the concurrency property tests race the production acquire.
- [hard] REQ-02: The property tests still prove exclusive acquisition under concurrency and monotonically increasing sequence numbers.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Claim tests acquire leases through the production path
